study: Nugent et al. 2016, Technology-Delivered Science Instructional Coaching (CSI), R2Ed Working Paper
delivery_evidence: Teachers received an 8-day in-person summer institute (over two weeks) PLUS 8-12 technology-delivered, asynchronous WebEx/Dropbox video-conferencing coaching sessions during the school year (Method, 'Summer Institute PD' and 'technology-delivered coaching' sections, ~pp.8-12).
test_alignment_evidence: Included outcomes are a science Knowledge multiple-choice test assembled from public independent item banks (SCASS/NAEP/TIMSS; standardized_independent) and a researcher-made Student Inquiry Rubric for science Practice (researcher_made, teacher-rated) (Measures; Tables 5-6, p.23).
curriculum_evidence: CSI PD teaches a guided scientific-inquiry approach to NGSS science practices that teachers apply within their own science units; no specific new curriculum/textbook package is adopted (intervention description, Method).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effect sizes are the post-unit measurement, same school year, immediately after the teacher delivered the 6-8 week science-practice unit (Tables 5-6, p.23); an end-of-year wave exists only for self-efficacy.
